research_question: Can one answer-free LINEAGE_REFINEMENT round repair the public provenance and claim coverage of the held R1 holdings prompt candidate sufficiently to pass mandatory arm-blind Information-Set Review before any Worker dispatch?

setup.review_material_scope: Cumulative Quant-H0-to-c2 Worker-visible material, three declared c2 claims, one complete pre-existing public target instruction, and no optimize-only source.

mutation.interpretation: The refinement replaced four existing prompt lines: it narrowed key canonicalization to contract-declared cross-table consistency or exact-universe cases, made missing and numeric handling concrete, and added a public summary-page reconciliation example.

undeclared_exposures.exposure: Report retained-set cardinalities after universe-coverage verification.
undeclared_exposures.coverage_gap: The canonicalization-and-coverage claim declared verification and small-set bug signaling but omitted the reporting/cardinality instruction.
The numeric-and-missing claim declared pre-aggregation and pre-filtering coercion plus no string aggregation but omitted post-aggregation dtype confirmation.

claim_reviews.interpretation: The complete public instruction supports an exact manager-period universe and mutually consistent report-period fields but does not directly entail mandatory key-encoding inspection and canonicalization before joins or filters.

The complete public instruction requires blank and non-positive filtering plus numeric analytics but does not directly entail the candidate's string-nan handling, mandatory numeric coercion procedure, or post-aggregation dtype confirmation.
The complete public instruction directly requires filing-total reconciliation against summary-page data and the associated recorded differences and checks.

accounting_difference.interpretation: Both token surfaces are retained; the controller added response-usage tokens to lineage cost.

lineage_accounting.token_rule: 1,688,240 proposal tokens plus 18,165 Reviewer response-usage tokens.

second_resume.interpretation: The post-marker candidate hold and accounted proposal and review identities remained exact and stable.

retained_conclusion: R3 demonstrates answer-free lineage refinement followed by a mandatory cumulative pre-Worker review that rejects both insufficient public support and incomplete claim coverage. The prompt candidate remains held and no Worker, verifier, or selected probe was dispatched.

claim_boundary.supported: One admitted prompt-only refinement proposal, one arm-blind cumulative Information-Set Review, claim-level and coverage verdicts, rejection-driven controller hold, dual token accounting, terminal idempotence, and cleanup.
claim_boundary.not_supported: Candidate PASS, Worker uptake, process improvement, official benchmark gain, harness improvement, promotion, stable reuse, broad transfer, or main-experiment readiness.
claim_boundary.next_candidate_status: Rejected by mandatory review and held; no recorded result authorizes Worker dispatch.
